issue.title: Fix inner hits retrieval when stored fields are disabled (_none_)

labels.name: :Search/Search
labels.description: Search-related issues that do not fall into other categories

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Now that types are unique per mapping we can retrieve the document mapper
without referencing the type. This fixes an NPE when stored fields are disabled.
For 6x we'll need a different fix since mappings can still have multiple types.

Relates #32941
